envelope.description: Give the chat host the queued turn runner

body.title: Give the chat host the queued turn runner
body.summary: chat-panel.ts: runQueued as the QueuedTurnRunner: show the message's chat (opening the panel when closed) with a note, post 'turn-running' (protocol.ts gains it; the webview enters its running state), push the user row and echo at run time, start the turn, and resolve the outcome: done, failed with the error, stopped by the stop flag set on cancel-turn, detached-ended after a detached CLI exits, stopped for a pipe turn or a turn dropped before it started, failed for a missing chat; continuations (the grant re-run, the selection continuation) run under the lease and the message resolves after the last one, a waiting card ending at an answer, Stop, a chat switch, the panel closing or CONTINUATION_WAIT_MS.
acceptanceChecks: A queued turn that starts on its own puts the webview in its running state so Stop is offered
Stop leaves the message failed 'stopped by the user' even though the stopped CLI reports a terminal error
The runner resolves for every way a turn ends, including detached, pipe, dropped before start and a missing chat, and only after continuations end

tests.name: chat host: the queued turn runner shows the message's chat (opening the panel when it is closed), resolves only after a grant re-run continuation ends, resolves stopped when a waiting card gets no answer within the wait, resolves detached-ended only after a detached CLI exits and stopped for a pipe turn, resolves stopped when the turn is dropped before it starts (a chat switch during the session-lease wait), and fails a message whose chat no longer exists
